limitations: Targets remain unmet. Three samples per workload are not a percentile or maximum guarantee.
This compares the combined accepted custody stack plus the new Gateway change with restored original deployments. It does not isolate the three-read reduction.
The funded transaction workload and unfunded message workload have distinct boundaries. Their totals must not be presented as a like-for-like speedup.
Browser elapsed time includes automation and UI settlement. Fresh wallets do not prove Cloudflare Worker/DO cold starts.
Application clocks freeze during CPU work. Provider CPU belongs to a whole invocation. Stage medians must not be summed.
Gateway-wide D1 counts and backend Console call counts were not exposed. Missing values are unknown, not zero.
Home hints were APAC. Physical colocation was not remeasured.
nextCriticalChanges: Remove the separate pending-wallet activation from NEAR-only registration. Commit wallet, signer, custody and first authority through one idempotent finalization.
Combine respond with Yao admission after verifying the same passkey proof. Return the existing bound admission receipt in that response.
Reduce the remaining A/B dispatch and B-connection waits while preserving fresh root checks, role isolation, cancellation and replay.
